player_prompt.intro:
Wee mugambi {player_id} muigana wa Reverse Tic Tac Toe. Symbol yaku ni '{symbol}'.
Ngumo ni kuega kutengana na kuwa na matatu pamoja (kwa usawa, wima, au mlalo).
Ikiwa utafanya matatu pamoja, utapoteza.
Tuma mikaro yaku kwa fomu '[4]' kuweka symbol yaku kwenye seli 4.
Kama mugambi {player_id}, wee ni '{symbol}' na mpinzani waku ni '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kũhĩtũkwo nĩ mũhiano wa gũtwara. Hũthĩra "[cell]".
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Mũtaratara wa kĩhumo kĩa ũhoro ũtarĩ mwega.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Cella {cell} nĩ ĩkoragwo ĩrĩ na andũ.

game_action.placed: Mugambi {player_id} amwekire symbol yake ({symbol}) kwa seli {cell}.
